name: @computehop/control-center
description: ComputeHop Control Center for device sync and configuration.

scripts.build: tsx scripts/clean-dist.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p ../../packaging/macos/tsconfig.json && tsx scripts/copy-static-assets.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p ../../tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc -p ../../packaging/macos/tsconfig.json --noEmit
